name: design-system-html-conformance
description: Pinned contributor-only HTML conformance checks for generated representative pages.

scripts.validate: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && find fixtures/static-renderer/public -name '*.html' -print0 | xargs -0 html-validate --rule doctype-style:off --rule no-trailing-whitespace:off --rule prefer-button:off --rule no-implicit-button-type:off --rule aria-label-misuse:off
